paragraphs.text: Leap clean over the two-yoked course of being and not-being, and bow to the Third: wonderful Shambhu. And here is the contagion part — gods, seers and men in this unfree triple world may be bound, but His hangers-on, the ones who live off Him alone, are free. Freedom spreads by contact.

Then loves instruments, one by one. Remembering His body, gem-set with the whole world: the one medicine for existence-pain — hold it and sit easy. Begging Him for one moon-sliver glance, luminous, cool, nectar-flowing. Hearts meeting His in union, the one high vessel of the ruling Ladies. Meditation-nectar flooding over low ground like water finding it. The ever-ringing Shiva-din that makes hard pains flee. Roaring and dancing when the Master is won — since He utterly delights.

And the supremacy with no second: the moon-crowned high Lord alone. No other yoga to do, no other knowing to get — Thou, all-one full Knowing, unfold. A great Person, shelter of persons, none left out. A play-lake for an ocean. Miseries shamed by His plain appearing. Beads told inside oneness, the knower inside the known — closing keen and swooning.
